A '''hidden cave''' located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], was used as a secret base by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire. Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]] and former [[Havoc Squad]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|commando]] [[Vanto Bazren]] developped experimental weapons in the cave after the latter betrayed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by defecting to the Empire.<ref name="TOR:Sandstorm" />
